scope: Survey-grounded AI4AI catalog organized as Benchmarks, Harness Design, and Model Design.
overlap_policy: A paper may appear in multiple public collections but only once within each collection.
citation_policy: For papers indexed as multiple versions, retain the largest title-verified count reported by the configured sources.
year_grouping: All yearly rankings use first public appearance year; a later venue year never moves a paper into a newer cohort.

research_refresh.note: Screened 2,132 unique recent cs.AI/cs.CL/cs.RO titles with expanded benchmark, training, distillation, optimization, reasoning and memory coverage, overlapping the November23 full pass and trailing30days. Reused103 documented prior scope exclusions; verified188 additional primary abstracts and explicit v1 histories: 115 additions and73 scope exclusions. Preserved original dates of historical omissions. Resolved one existing alphaXiv-only record to its newly available arXiv identity, without duplicating it. Checked17 official project/artifact sources, discovering six further official GitHub repos. Re-searched official vendor news indexes and reassessed all10 prior picks. Under explicit maintainer delegation to select Top10 and push without confirmation, directly published the November24 edition with six research and four flagship stories, true first-public dates and primary-source attribution. Bounded search, not global literature completeness.
